title: 49ers think there's "a chance" they can trade Brandon Aiyuk

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: 49ers think there's "a chance" they can trade Brandon Aiyuk
sources.description: 49ers General Manager John Lynch said in January that it was safe to say that wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk had played his final snap with the team, but the wideout remains on the team's roster more than a month into the 2026 league year.
